LESSON: LANGUAGE USE 7.3.1 USE OF CONJUNCTIONS

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade two
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.3: Language Use 7.3.1 Use of conjunctions
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Language Use 7.3.1 Use of conjunctions, part of Strand 7 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade two General.

Key inquiry question: What do we say when we want to choose something from a group of things?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Language Use 7.3.1 Use of conjunctions together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Communication: The learner’s speaking skills are enhanced as they speak clearly and effectively using conjunction ‘or’ correctly.

Values:
Responsibility is enhanced as the learner takes up roles during group activities such as role playing.

Link to

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Education for Sustainable Development- (disaster risk reduction): The learner’s safety is enhanced as they sing and recite poems about

safety.

Links to other Learning Areas:
The use of conjunction ‘or’ is also learnt in Kiswahili Language Activities

Suggested Learning Resources:

Poems, songs, assistive technology such as universal cuffs/wrist braces/arm braces, weighted pencil/pen grips, page-turners, adapted digital devices

Other Related Service Providers: Resource person, speech therapist, Learner support assistance, Occupational Therapist, Physiotherapist.
